Two candidate fetches were subject-verified as failing the topic: 'LGBTQ people in prison' (en.wikipedia) mentions Poland only in a HEUNI prison-health-care citation (MacDonald 2018) unrelated to trans housing, and 'Transgender rights in Poland' (en.wikipedia) contains no prisoner-placement content (its only 'prison' mentions concern an activist facing imprisonment and imprisoned anti-abortion activists). Polish prisons are administered centrally by the Central Board of the Prison Service (national system), so trans-prisoner housing is a national-policy question rather than a voivodeship one; no voivodeship-specific trans-prisoner placement policy, facility or case was located within the permitted search/fetch budget. adds=[] is the honest result; no fabrication.
